Instructions for Use
Device description: The Willow Aneurysm Clip is a intracranial aneurysm clip. It is available in lengths from 12 mm to 28 mm.
Warnings: For single use only. Do not resterilize. Store at 15 °C to 30 °C.
Refer to the surgical technique guide for implantation instructions.

MRI Safety Information
MR Conditional (1.5 T or 3 T): at 1.5 T: whole-body averaged SAR of 1 W/kg or less, Limit total active scanning to 30 min; at 3 T: B1+RMS of 1.7 microtesla or less; for MR scanners that do not report B1+rms, Whole-Body SAR ≤ 1.5 W/kg, Maximum Head SAR 0.1 W/kg, No more than 20 minutes of active scan time per session; Normal Operating Mode.
Image artifact: up to 40 mm.
Patients may be scanned immediately after implantation.
